title: Estimating Congestion Benefits of Batteries for Unobserved Networks
Valuing Solar Subsidies
abstract: Individuals trade present for future consumption across a range of economic behaviors, and this tradeoff may differ across socioeconomic groups. To assess these tradeoffs, we estimate a dynamic model of residential solar adoption and system sizing in California using household-level data on solar irradiance, electricity consumption, and electricity rates that offer plausibly exogenous variation in the future benefits from adopting relative to upfront costs. We find implicit discount rates of 15.3%, 13.8%, and 10.0% for low-, medium-, and high-wealth households. Counterfactual simulations demonstrate opportunities to reduce the regressivity of solar adoption, increase policy cost-effectiveness, and improve welfare for low-wealth households. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 个人在一系列经济行为中都会在当下消费与未来消费之间进行权衡，而这种权衡可能因社会经济群体而异。为评估这些权衡，我们利用加利福尼亚州家庭层面关于太阳辐照度、用电量和电价的数据，估计了住宅太阳能采用和系统规模的动态模型。这些数据提供了相对于前期成本、采用太阳能未来收益的、具有合理外生性的变异。我们发现，低、中、高财富家庭的隐含贴现率分别为15.3%、13.8%和10.0%。反事实模拟表明，存在降低太阳能采用累退性、提高政策成本效益以及改善低财富家庭福利的机会。美国国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可免费从www.nber.org下载本文。

title: Self- and Social Signaling: Evidence from Solar Adoption in California
abstract: Prosocial behavior plays a role in many economic contexts, and it has been explained by altruism, social pressure, signaling, and expectations of fairness and reciprocity. We examine prosocial behavior in a context that allows us to distinguish the role of self-signaling and social signaling from alternative explanations, including warm glow. Our context is residential solar, and self-signaling is separately identified from social signaling by the exogenous visibility of potential solar arrays. We show that the political affiliation of proximate peers influences the extent of self-signaling and is crowded out by the private benefits of installing solar. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 亲社会行为在许多经济情境中都发挥作用，已有研究用利他主义、社会压力、信号传递以及对公平与互惠的预期来解释它。我们考察了一个能够将自我信号传递和社会信号传递的作用与其他解释（包括“暖光效应”）区分开来的情境。我们的研究情境是住宅太阳能，自我信号传递可以通过潜在太阳能板阵列的外生可见性与社会信号传递分开识别。我们发现，邻近同伴的政治派别会影响自我信号传递的程度，并且会被安装太阳能所带来的私人收益所挤出。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可以在www.nber.org上免费下载本文。

title: Distributional Consequences of Policies for Electric Heat Conversion
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We study the adoption of air-source heat pumps for home heating. We estimate that 5% of already-built homes converted to heat pumps during 2010–20, while 22% of new homes built during this period chose heat pumps. New adoptions concentrate among rural households in the South. Conversions are more diffuse, covering urban and rural households in every region. Conversions are more prevalent in areas with mild winters and cheap electricity relative to other fuels but are less strongly associated with energy costs than adoptions in new homes. To better understand the distributional implications going forward, we calculate the annual energy-cost savings from switching to a heat pump for a large sample of US households based on their current heating fuels, climate, and local energy prices. We find massive variation, with low-income households in the Northeast and Appalachians benefiting the most.
abstract_zh: 我们研究家庭供暖中空气源热泵的采用情况。我们估计，2010至2020年间，已建成住房中有5%改用了热泵，而同期新建住房中有22%选择了热泵。新增采用主要集中在美国南部的农村家庭。改造式采用则较为分散，覆盖各地区的城市和农村家庭。在冬季温和、且电力相对于其他燃料较便宜的地区，改造式采用更为普遍，但与新建住房的采用相比，改造式采用与能源成本的关联较弱。为了更好地理解未来的分配效应，我们基于大量美国家庭当前的供暖燃料、气候和当地能源价格，计算了改用热泵每年可节省的能源成本。我们发现存在巨大差异，东北部和阿巴拉契亚地区的低收入家庭获益最多。

title: Visibility and Peer Influence in Durable Good Adoption
Heterogeneous Environmental and Grid Benefits from Rooftop Solar and the Costs of Inefficient Siting Decisions
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Federal and state policies in the U.S. subsidize electricity generation from 1.4 million rooftop solar arrays because of pollution avoidance benefits and grid congestion relief. Yet because these benefits vary across the U.S. according to solar irradiance, technologies of electricity generators, and grid characteristics, the value of these benefits, and, consequently, the optimal subsidy, are largely unknown. Policy, therefore, is unlikely to have induced efficient solar investments. This paper (1) provides the first systematic, theoretically consistent, and empirically valid estimates of pollution damages avoidable by solar capacity in each U.S. zip code, (2) relates these external benefits to subsidy levels in each U.S. state, and (3) estimates the share of these benefits that spillover to other states. It also measures the energy value of capacity across the U.S. and the value of transmission congestion relief in California. Environmental benefits are shown to vary considerably across the U.S., and to largely spillover to neighboring states. Subsidy levels are essentially uncorrelated with environmental benefits contributing to installed capacity that sacrifices approximately $1 billion per year in environmental benefits. Energy value is estimated to vary less than environmental benefits, while California rooftop solar is shown to generate no congestion relief.
abstract_zh: 美国联邦和州政府的政策为140万个屋顶太阳能装置的发电提供补贴，理由是其可以避免污染并缓解电网拥堵。然而，由于这些效益会因太阳辐照度、发电技术和电网特征而在美国各地存在差异，其价值以及由此决定的最优补贴水平在很大程度上并不清楚。因此，现行政策不太可能诱导出有效率的太阳能投资。本文（1）首次系统地、理论上一致且经验上有效地估计了美国每个邮编区内太阳能装机容量可避免的污染损害；（2）将这些外部效益与各州的补贴水平相联系；（3）估计了这些效益溢出到其他州的份额。本文还测算了美国各地装机容量的能源价值，以及加利福尼亚州输电拥堵缓解的价值。研究表明，环境效益在美国各地差异显著，并且很大程度上会溢出到邻近各州。补贴水平与促成装机容量的环境效益基本不相关，导致每年约10亿美元的环境效益被牺牲。能源价值的变化幅度小于环境效益，而加利福尼亚州的屋顶太阳能并未显示出任何拥堵缓解作用。

title: Investing in local capacity to respond to a federal environmental mandate: Forest & economic impacts of the Green Municipality Program in the Brazilian Amazon
abstract: Over the past decade, the Brazilian federal government has offered a negative collective incentive to reduce deforestation by ‘blacklisting’ the municipalities in the Amazon with the highest deforestation rates. As for any unfunded mandate, the responses to blacklisting depend on both local incentives and local capacities. We evaluate a state program − Programa Municípios Verdes (PMV) or the Green Municipality Program – to increase the capacity of municipal governments in the state of Pará to respond to this federal incentive. The PMV is voluntary, as municipal governments choose whether to participate. To control for differences due to self-selection into the program, we employ quasi-experimental methods: two-way, fixed-effects regressions in matched samples of municipalities; and the synthetic control method that compares outcomes in a participating municipality to outcomes in a weighted blend of control municipalities. Neither approach suggests that the PMV reduced deforestation beyond the effect of the blacklist. We hypothesize that municipalities joined the PMV to ameliorate the costs of complying with blacklist requirements, including the costs of exiting the blacklist. We show that the PMV increased total value added – with substantial heterogeneity - in participating blacklisted municipalities, and that these gains likely are not due to agricultural intensification. They may result from reductions in compliance risk and cost that make economic investments in a municipality more appealing. In the long run, this could make forest conservation more socially and politically sustainable.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，巴西联邦政府对亚马逊地区砍伐率最高的市镇实施“黑名单”制度，以此提供一种负向集体激励，促使其减少毁林。与任何无资金支持的强制性任务一样，对黑名单的反应既取决于地方激励，也取决于地方能力。我们评估了一项州级项目——Programa Municípios Verdes（PMV），即绿色市镇计划——旨在提升帕拉州市级政府应对这一联邦激励的能力。PMV是自愿性的，市级政府可自行选择是否参与。为控制因自选择参与项目而产生的差异，我们采用准实验方法：在匹配样本市镇中进行双向固定效应回归，以及合成控制方法，将参与市镇的结果与控制市镇的加权组合进行比较。两种方法均表明，PMV并未在黑名单效应之外进一步减少毁林。我们推测，市镇加入PMV是为了减轻遵守黑名单要求的成本，包括退出黑名单的成本。我们表明，PMV增加了总增加值（在参与的被列入黑名单的市镇中存在显著异质性），而且这些收益很可能并非源于农业集约化。它们可能源于合规风险与成本的降低，从而使市镇内的经济投资更具吸引力。从长远看，这可能使森林保护在社会与政治上更具可持续性。

title: Household Discount Rates and Net Energy Metering Incentives for Rooftop Solar Adoption
Estimating the Impacts of Local Policy Innovation: The Synthetic Control Method Applied to Tropical Deforestation
abstract: Quasi-experimental methods increasingly are used to evaluate the impacts of conservation interventions by generating credible estimates of counterfactual baselines. These methods generally require large samples for statistical comparisons, presenting a challenge for evaluating innovative policies implemented within a few pioneering jurisdictions. Single jurisdictions often are studied using comparative methods, which rely on analysts' selection of best case comparisons. The synthetic control method (SCM) offers one systematic and transparent way to select cases for comparison, from a sizeable pool, by focusing upon similarity in outcomes before the intervention. We explain SCM, then apply it to one local initiative to limit deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon. The municipality of Paragominas launched a multi-pronged local initiative in 2008 to maintain low deforestation while restoring economic production. This was a response to having been placed, due to high deforestation, on a federal "blacklist" that increased enforcement of forest regulations and restricted access to credit and output markets. The local initiative included mapping and monitoring of rural land plus promotion of economic alternatives compatible with low deforestation. The key motivation for the program may have been to reduce the costs of blacklisting. However its stated purpose was to limit deforestation, and thus we apply SCM to estimate what deforestation would have been in a (counterfactual) scenario of no local initiative. We obtain a plausible estimate, in that deforestation patterns before the intervention were similar in Paragominas and the synthetic control, which suggests that after several years, the initiative did lower deforestation (significantly below the synthetic control in 2012). This demonstrates that SCM can yield helpful land-use counterfactuals for single units, with opportunities to integrate local and expert knowledge and to test innovations and permutations on policies that are implemented in just a few locations.
abstract_zh: 准实验方法越来越多地被用于评估保护干预措施的影响，其途径是生成可信的反事实基准。这些方法通常需要较大的样本以进行统计比较，这给评估仅在少数先行地区实施的创新政策带来了挑战。对于单一地区，通常采用比较方法进行研究，但这依赖于分析者对最佳比较案例的选择。合成控制法（SCM）提供了一种系统且透明的方法，可以从庞大的备选池中，依据干预前结果的相似性来选择比较案例。我们阐述了SCM，并将其应用于巴西亚马逊地区一项限制森林砍伐的地方性倡议。帕拉戈米纳斯（Paragominas）市于2008年发起了一项多管齐下的地方性倡议，旨在维持较低的森林砍伐水平，同时恢复经济生产。这一倡议是对该市因高森林砍伐率而被列入联邦“黑名单”的回应，该名单加强了对森林法规的执法，并限制了其获得信贷和进入产品市场的机会。该地方倡议包括对农村土地进行测绘和监测，并推广与低森林砍伐相容的经济替代方案。该项目的主要动机可能是降低被列入黑名单的成本。然而，其既定目标是限制森林砍伐，因此我们运用SCM估计，在没有该地方倡议的（反事实）情景下，森林砍伐将会是什么水平。我们得到了一个合理的估计：干预前帕拉戈米纳斯与合成控制地区的森林砍伐格局相似，这表明经过数年，该倡议确实降低了森林砍伐（在2012年显著低于合成控制地区）。这说明，SCM能够为单一单元提供有益的土地利用反事实，并且有机会整合地方和专家知识，检验仅在少数地点实施的政策的创新与变体。

title: Promoting Clean Energy Investment: An Empirical Analysis of Property Assessed Clean Energy
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: From 2008 to 2010 a handful of Property-Assessed Clean Energy (PACE) programs offered property-secured loans to homeowners for residential clean energy investments. This analysis uses difference-in-differences models and synthetic counterfactual models to estimate the effect of three California PACE programs on residential photovoltaic installations. While PACE programs do not offer superior terms to other solar financing options, we find that PACE financing increases solar installations by approximately 3.8. watts per owner-occupied household per quarter, a 108% increase over the mean watts per owner-occupied household.
abstract_zh: 2008年至2010年间，少数几个“物业评估清洁能源”（PACE）计划向房主提供以房产作担保的贷款，用于住宅清洁能源投资。本文采用双重差分模型和合成反事实模型，估计了加利福尼亚州三个PACE计划对住宅光伏装机的影响。尽管PACE计划提供的条款并不优于其他太阳能融资选择，但我们发现，PACE融资使每个自住家庭每季度的太阳能装机容量增加约3.8瓦，相当于自住家庭平均瓦数增加108%。
